title: Mochizuki Honami — Daydreams For The Future〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew... Okay, where are Ichika and the others...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, is no one else here?
Does that mean...? Did I come over too early?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And the corridor's so quiet.
It doesn't seem like they're in any of the other classrooms...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I doubt anything has changed, but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I'll go take another look at the tree...
Station
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, in front of the tree. That looks like...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Rin, Len.
Can I ask what you two are doing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, Hona!
We were just checking up on the tree!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Between those black fragments appearing and it growing humongous all of a sudden, we feel that we should come by from time to time to make sure it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Thank you both for taking such initiative.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also came here to see how it's doing, but nothing seems to have changed...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Based on the way the leaves have been rustling today, it seems happy and healthy♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That said, there's no telling when something might change again. So, we'll keep checking up on it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Please let me know if you think there's anything I can do to help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, we will.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Hona, has anything changed on your end? Any news to report?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, nothing has changed.
But I do keep finding myself thinking about that dream.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Looking back, it really was strange...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because we clearly wanted to be with each other regardless of where we were or what we were doing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ichika, Saki and Shiho all feel that way.
None of us wish to be apart.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Which makes me very happy...
So, I really am glad that we had that dream.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you two and the others were right next to us the entire time we were stuck in that dream, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
This may be coming a bit late...
But thank you all again for showing so much concern for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We sorta panicked and started doing everything we could to try and wake you girls up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We tried calling your names and shaking you, but nothing worked.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That was when Rin decided to grab a pair of cymbals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: C-Cymbals?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, you gotta hear this!
The others were so mean to me, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Girls! Wake up!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Nothing. They're still fast asleep...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... What should we do?
If they stay stuck like this, then their legs might get all stiff!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure that's our biggest worry right now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, I know! We just need to make an even louder sound! That should startle them and get them to wake up, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm gonna go grab some cymbals!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cymbals?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't think this is going to be a pleasant wake-up call...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Stand aside, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I gotta stand right in the middle so Ichi and them will hear me loud and clear... Okay, here goes nothing☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Riiise and shiiine, girls☆
It's moooorning!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're still asleep...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Alright, I'm gonna bring over some other instruments! I can even make things really loud by cranking some amps up to the max!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, Rin...!
If this didn't work, then there's no way any of that will!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-That really happened...?
We honestly had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When I tried to go get those amps, MEIKO and the others stopped me right away.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Well, yeah.
It was that or let something really bad happen.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, it's clear that you were very concerned about us. Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No problem! I'm just glad that you all woke up in the end!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But what are we supposed to do if something like this happens again? Do you know any other ways of getting people to wake up?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... Even those cymbals didn't wake us. Lights and smells tend to be effective, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Smells... Oh, Honami, in your case, a freshly baked apple pie might do the trick.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! You'll get so hungry that you won't have a choice but to wake up!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? That wouldn't happen... At least, I don't think...
